label: class_c_01_history_01
text: Oho... I see we have some new students here with\nus today.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: class_c_01_history_02
text: My name is Raifort. I will be the one to impart\nknowledge of the past to your little minds.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_03
text: History is a wonderful thing. Truly splendid.\c\nThe lives of our ancestors throughout history\nforged the path to the present in which we live![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_04
text: Today, you shall learn about the most mysterious\nlocation in all of Paldea—the Great Crater.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_05
text: As you are all aware, a massive crater known as\nthe Great Crater of Paldea exists in the heart of\r\nour region.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_06
text:
The area inside this crater is called Area Zero,
and research of its geological strata and material
composition has shown that the crater is in fact
over one million years old.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_07
text: It was long believed that [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]a certain something[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\nrested at the bottom of this mysterious crater.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_08
text: Aha. Perfect timing to make eye contact, young\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Answer me this...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_09
text: What exactly was believed to rest in the depths\nof the Great Crater—inside Area Zero?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_select_01
text: Treasure

label: class_c_01_select_02
text: A Snorlax

label: class_c_01_select_03
text: A Pokémon Center

label: class_c_01_history_answer_01
text: Heh. That is correct! You are a surprisingly clever\none, aren’t you? I see you did your homework\r\nprior to coming to my class.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_answer_02
text: Incorrect! An adorable answer, to be sure, but\nwere you perhaps fooled by my use of “rest”?\r\nThe correct answer is treasure.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_answer_03
text: Incorrect! An interesting answer, to be sure, but\nthat would be quite the anachronistic artifact.\r\nThe correct answer is treasure.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_10
text: That’s right! Some believed that a treasure more\nvaluable than anything else in this world rested in\r\nthe depths of the Great Crater![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_11
text: So much for dreams of treasure hunting, though,\nas a lab has been built in those very same depths.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_12
text:
Oh, and before I forget—you would all do well
to remember that the Great Crater and Area
Zero are both off-limits to all but those who
have official business there.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_13
text:
Do not dare entertain the foolish notion of
gallivanting off to Area Zero in search of riches.\c
It is no place for children dreaming of treasure
and adventure![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_14
text: Besides, if it were at all possible to investigate\nthe area, I would surely be the first to do so![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_15
text: Oho, is that the time already? I must’ve gotten\nswept up in filling your minds with knowledge.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_01_history_16
text: This ends today’s lesson. We will unravel more of\nhistory’s enigmas together next time.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
